entries.title: Leviticus 11:1
segments: This chapter treats of the distinction between clean and unclean meats, which entered largely into Jewish habits of thinking and acting.  It cannot be reasonable doubted that the clean animals here allowed were those which, to the people of that region, furnished the most wholesome diet.  But the distinction had a much deeper meaning.  It typified the inward difference which God's servants should make between clean and unclean affections, and the holy of unholy acts that proceed from them. Another end of these distinctions was to keep the Hebrews separate from all other nations, as a people devoted to Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:2
segments: In eating and drinking, we should seek not merely to gratify appetite or preserve life, health, and reason, but to fit ourselves for the best discharge of our duties.  Whatever as to kind, quality, or quantity, tends to unfit us for this, should be rejected.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:3
segments: Cloven-footed; having the hoof divided into two parts, like that of the ox and sheep.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:5
segments: Coney; a small animal inhabiting high, rocky places.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:8
segments: Great attention and care are needful to avoid the commission of sin, and exposure to its punishment.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:10
segments: An abomination;  to be loathed and rejected.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:13
segments: Among the fowls; it is plain that the unclean birds here named are mostly, if not entirely, birds of prey, or such as feed on carrion. But the particular species cannot, in all cases, be determined.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:20
segments: Fowls that creep; winged insects.  See

entries.title: Leviticus 11:21
segments: Legs above their feet; those which, in addition to the feet on which they walk, have long legs with which to jump; as locusts and grasshoppers.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:23
segments: Flying creeping things; as flies, wasps, and bees.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:24
segments:
. 
 
  Unclean until the even; not admitted to unite in public worship, or associate with others who united in it.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:25
segments: Pollution by sin, and need of spiritual cleansing by the Holy Ghost, were taught abundantly in the Jewish ritual; and none who understand its teaching, can be ignorant of the doctrine of human depravity and the necessity of being born in order to see the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:29
segments: Creeping things; by these the Hebrews understand small animals that move with a low or a crawling motion, as well as serpents and worms. Few of the particular species here mentioned can be determined with any certainty.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:45
segments: Holiness is to all men the one thing needful.  In every heart where it exists, it is the fruit of the Holy Spirit.  Hence, the reason why all men should hearken diligently to his voice speaking to them in the Bible, receive his teachings as infallible truth, and cordially obey them.
